checks.claim: The masked scalar product reconstructs its modular reference.
checks.scope: All scalar w,x,r,s in Z/256Z. Does not prove software implementation or integer no-wrap bounds.

checks.claim: An inverse exists for every scalar masked transcript and fixed input.
checks.scope: Finite ring map with independent uniform masks; counting argument in the document supplies ideal-view privacy. No claim about pseudorandom masks or adaptive composition.

checks.claim: Including the carry gives exact narrowing-ring truncation.
checks.scope: All two 8-bit shares truncated to a 4-bit result; no secure carry implementation or widening is proved.

checks.claim: Independent share shifts can give the wrong result.
checks.scope: Deliberately weakened arithmetic; counterexample is not an attack on a reviewed truncation protocol.

checks.claim: Signed 24-to-16-bit narrowing is exact within the certified range.
checks.scope: Single signed bounded integer; range certificate provenance is an external obligation.

checks.claim: Narrowing without an input bound changes the function.
checks.scope: A public small output alphabet alone does not justify discarding input information.

checks.claim: Reusing a mask exposes the exact input difference.
checks.scope: Identity for every pair of 8-bit inputs and a reused mask; this verifies a leakage identity, not privacy.

checks.claim: A public rank-one mask exposes its left-nullspace projection.
checks.scope: The example U=(1,1) masks two coordinates with one scalar; it is deliberately insecure.

checks.claim: Can one record be transmitted for two different values?
checks.scope: Six-transition abstract allocator, two input values, no clones or process crashes; binding is monotone.

checks.claim: Can one record be transmitted for two different values?
checks.scope: Six-transition abstract allocator, two input values, no clones or process crashes; timeout recycling enabled.

statement: These checks prove or refute only their explicit finite specifications. No full protocol or Rust refinement proof is claimed.
